correctness.rationale: The Fano incidence model is explicit and fixed. An elementary fort–forcing equivalence proves that the minimal-fort hypergraph exactly controls all zero-forcing seeds. Two independently written programs use XOR-line and orthogonality-normal models and separately exhaust every one of 2^14 vertex masks. The first verifies all proper-subset fort minimality by exact recurrence, full 336-element automorphism group, each minimal-fort and minimum-set orbit and propagation time; the second uses an independent all-submask test, minimal-fort hitting and a separate direct forcing closure. Both reproduce 70 minimal forts (orbits 14 and 56), 700 minimum zero-forcing seeds (orbits 28 and 168 four times), total forcing count 8324, and exact polynomial. The representative certificate is checked against both models. Finite exhaustiveness is valid here because all 16384 masks are covered, and no extrapolation to infinite families is made.

value.rationale: The Heawood graph is the canonical Fano plane Levi graph and a classical 3-regular girth-six symmetric graph. The 70 inclusion-minimal forts provide a complete irredundant obstruction hypergraph for ordinary zero forcing; two explicit geometric automorphism classes explain their shape. The complete forcing polynomial, five distinct minimum-set symmetry orbits, well-forcedness, and precise two-round/three-round profile constitute a natural exact classification, not an arbitrary parameter slice or generic computational check. This information supports fort-hitting and dynamic forcing analyses while respecting known value Z(H)=6 and without claiming an all-orders theorem.
